description: This Java source file defines the class HibernateOpenmrsMetadataDAO, which provides data access methods for BaseOpenmrsMetadata entities within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for retrieving metadata records, optionally filtering out 'retired' records, with support for pagination and counting records.

classes.name: HibernateOpenmrsMetadataDAO
classes.description: A generic DAO implementation for managing BaseOpenmrsMetadata entities using Hibernate, supporting retrieval, pagination, and count operations.
